final: WITH g AS (SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId), s AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.ArtistId, g.c, CAST(g.c AS REAL) / s.tot AS share FROM g CROSS JOIN s WHERE s.tot IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM p), q AS (SELECT p.ArtistId, p.c, p.share, p.share - a.avgshare AS diff FROM p CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avgshare IS NOT NULL) SELECT ArtistId, c, share, diff FROM q ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
